items.title: Maruti Suzuki launches flex-fuel WagonR to support India’s ethanol push
items.summary: Describing it as the country's first flex-fuel passenger vehicle, company’s MD and CEO, Hisashi Takeuchi, said flex-fuel technology could support India's goals of reducing oil imports and carbon emissions.
